summary: Preserve explicit Email attachment provenance when a run-scoped workflow-classification overlay changes the parent's effective document type.
decision_refs: The active goal requires accurate combined RFI/Submittal/Email support
CR-0075 changes only the effective workflow view and must not erase immutable Email parsing provenance
FR-INGEST-006 requires selected attachment relationships to remain visible for parsed Email parents
approval_evidence: The persistent user goal explicitly requests continued accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: The fix preserves only explicit selected-attachment provenance; it does not recursively analyze attachments or infer workflow authority.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no mailbox, customer file, provider or paid model is used.
